scope: Targeted public primary-source acquisition recheck; not proof of global unavailability

sources.title: Exporting Mycenaean: From a Relational Database to EpiDoc XML files (and back again?)
sources.inspection: PDF text extracted; printed/PDF p.5 visually inspected
sources.finding: The described EpiDoc export omits linguistic analyses; item.id and phys_word.id preserve links to separately stored annotations. Export availability does not establish gold availability.
sources.time_boundary: Publication describes its implementation at writing; no claim that a newer export cannot exist.

sources.finding: Public documentation describes transliteration, word/co-occurrence searches, notes and metadata; it does not provide an aligned linguistic annotation package.
Pylos edition-variation work is ongoing; do not presume frozen derivatives contain it.
Photographs and layout/apparatus make LiBER a graphical candidate, but personal non-profit image use and limited scholarly text reuse do not establish permission for a redistributed bulk benchmark.

linguistic: Source-issued item.id and phys_word.id with token/line crosswalk
Separate morphological/syntactic/lexical assertions linked by source IDs
All competing analyses, uncertainty, source locators and lineage
Explicit snapshot/version and source-specific reuse terms
graphical: Image permissions separate from text/data permissions

next_action: Obtain a documented current annotation export or maintainer-supplied linked annotation package; separately acquire rights-compatible occurrence-level graphical evidence. Freeze inputs and scoring before any gold reveal.
prohibited_inferences: EpiDoc syntax or word IDs are linguistic gold
Unicode or Latin transliteration reconstructs graphical occurrences
A valid received package automatically permits gold reveal
